amy: quick FYI — ran the "compact-3" quant profile (FP8->INT8 AWQ chain) on onboarding-v3 over a 5k sample eval split. seeing a 3.8% absolute drop in table-extract F1 on financial_table_v2 and a clear hallucination spike for free-text "reason" fields. also noticed HTML snippets return < > entities instead of raw < > in outputs. jay: can you paste the exact run command + config you used? amy: yup — minimal snippet below: amy: ```yaml model: onboarding-v3 quant_profile: compact-3 strategy: stage1: awq-int8 stage2: fallback-gptq batching: mode: continuous max_batch: 8 kv_cache: splitpack: true deploy_profile: shared-pool-us-west eval_sets: [financial_table_v2, invoice-extract, html-snippets] seeds: [42, 101, 202] ``` lucas: interesting — did you try dedicated pool (no splitpack) for comparison? could be packing boundaries shifting tokens. amy: ran both. shared-pool: 3.8% F1 drop. dedicated (no splitpack): 2.1% drop. so splitpack seems to exacerbate it. AWQ-int8 worse on numeric-field fidelity; GPTQ-int8 had milder hallucination but ~12% higher tail latency. sophia: what about seed variance? is this a fluke or stable across seeds? amy: 3 seeds — stdev ~0.6% F1 on financial_table_v2. hallucination rate (free-text reason) jumped from 0.9% -> 4.7% median under compact-3. correlated with prompts containing inline HTML or CSV-escaped quotes. marta: could this be tokenizer/decode problem where some bytes get mapped differently after quant kernel changes? jay: try decoding with html.unescape during postproc as a quick band-aid. also run token-level diffs between fp16 baseline and quant outputs for the same random seed. amy: plan for triage: 1) reproduce minimal repro (single prompt with and a numeric cell) 2) run quantized model with force-fp16 kernels (avoid awq kernel path) to isolate kernel vs quant mapping 3) dump kv-cache token ids at each step for shared vs dedicated pools 4) run tokenizer.decode(token_ids) and html.unescape on both outputs and compare 5) add a targeted eval test (html-escape + numeric-fidelity) into nightly harness amy: minimal repro prompt + outputs: amy: ```text PROMPT: Please extract the table and reasons:
acctamount
INV-1231,234.56
FP16 BASELINE OUTPUT: [{"acct":"INV-123","amount":"1,234.56","reason":"Payment received "}] COMPACT-3 AWQ-INT8 OUTPUT: [{"acct":"INV-123","amount":"1,234.56","reason":"Payment received <confirmed>"}] ``` lucas: neat repro — the raw token ids will tell if it's a decode-only problem. can you attach token ids for the "reason" tail? amy: attaching token-id dump shortly. early glance: token id sequence differs starting at the token for '<' (baseline token 4732 vs quant token 8811). not just decode mapping — upstream token id appears changed. sophia: that points at tokenizer vocabulary or embedding table mapping mismatch after quant packing. maybe quant reorder in AWQ reassigns indices for rare tokens during kernel packing. marta: if AWQ packing is reordering embedding rows to optimize cache, we need a mapping table to keep token-id->embedding consistent. is that in compact-3? amy: compact-3 uses packing that condenses rare-token rows. i will repro with packing disabled and with explicit remap check. infra-bot: canary deploy scheduled: compact-3-dedicated-canary -> us-west (deploy id: canary-215600-07). good to hold off wide rollout until triage. jay: Add two quick tests to our CI: (a) html-escape roundtrip on 100 examples, (b) token-id identity check between baseline and quantized mapping. if either fails, block rollout. amy: will open PR with repro, token dumps, and CI changes. tagging @lucas @sophia for review. lucas: also add a short note in the model-onboarding doc about "packing-induced token mapping changes" and recommended mitigations (disable packing for HTML-rich tasks, or keep a stable remap). amy: will do. thanks — posting dumps now. :thumbsup:
